Headline: #93 California/Dodge Temporary Reroute at California/Montrose
ShortDescription: #93 California/Dodge buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, a festival near California/Montrose.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#93 California/Dodge buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via California, Irving Park, Western, Lawrence, and Kedzie due to a festival near California/Montrose.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #35 35th Temporary Reroute near 31st Street Beach
ShortDescription: #35 35th  buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near 31st Street Beach.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#35 31st/35th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near 31st Street Beach.

Westbound buses will operate via 31st, King Drive, 35th, Rhodes, 33rd, Cottage Grove, and 35th then resume their normal route. 

Eastbound buses will operate via 35th, Rhodes, 33rd, Rhodes, and 31st then resume their normal route. 

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Westbound #72 North Temporary Westbound Reroute near LaSalle/Inner Lake Shore Drive
ShortDescription: Westbound #72 North buses are temporarily rerouted due to, a festival near LaSalle/Inner Lake Shore Drive.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Westbound #72 North buses are temporarily rerouted via Clark, LaSalle, Inner Lake Shore Drive, Division, Clark, and North Ave. then resume their normal route due to, a festival near LaSalle/Inner Lake Shore Drive.

Eastbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
